bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
command -v gh >/dev/null || exit 63
gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link62-baseline.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/base" "$tmp/target"
gh run download 44583321273 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$tmp/base" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
gh run download 44752721601 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$tmp/target" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 66
test -s "$tmp/base/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 67
test -s "$tmp/target/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 68
docker cp deploy-gaybbs-1:/app/gaybbs.mjs "$tmp/live.mjs"
test -s "$tmp/live.mjs" || exit 69
node --check "$tmp/target/gaybbs.mjs" >/dev/null || exit 70
if cmp -s "$tmp/base/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/live.mjs"; then echo LIVE_EQUALS_PR58_BASELINE=YES; else echo LIVE_EQUALS_PR58_BASELINE=NO; exit 71; fi
echo LINK_ONLY_BUNDLE_PROVENANCE=PASS
echo PROD_UNTOUCHED=YES
